build: Modwerk's linker: core-ar2 0.7 + this folder's Live Rec Retrig Fix 0.2.1-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version LR23

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: no card image (the card starts formatted); JIT on; --every 1000M, every event off it

conditions: Cold boot; six NO presses clear the notices. First capture: GLOBAL, six DOWNs and YES open CONTROL, two DOWNs and YES open SEQUENCER CONFIG, eight DOWNs reach its last row, QUANT RTRG TO SEQ, checked by default. Second: RTRG held from the kit screen, YES on the RETRIG row turns ALWAYS ON over (the same run without YES shows it unchecked); the frame is taken with RTRG still held. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.

captures.plan: DTBOOT_STEPS=1 DTBOOT_PNG_DIR=out dtboot lr23.syx --instr 12500M --every 1000M --press NO@3200M --press NO@3500M --press NO@3800M --press NO@4100M --press NO@4400M --press NO@4700M --press GLOBAL@5100M --press DOWN@5800M --press DOWN@6050M --press DOWN@6300M --press DOWN@6550M --press DOWN@6800M --press DOWN@7050M --press YES@7600M --press DOWN@7900M --press DOWN@8150M --press YES@8400M --press DOWN@8700M --press DOWN@8950M --press DOWN@9200M --press DOWN@9450M --press DOWN@9700M --press DOWN@9950M --press DOWN@10200M --press DOWN@10450M (frame after the last DOWN)

DTBOOT_END_PNG=retrig-always-on.png dtboot lr23.syx --instr 5703M --every 1000M --press NO@3200M --press NO@3500M --press NO@3800M --press NO@4100M --press NO@4400M --press NO@4700M --press RTRG@5103M:800M --press YES@5403M:12M
